svg.title: Ann-Diana's personal terminal
svg.desc: What is your background? I work in communication in an IT environment and have experience in frontend work. Exploring AI led me deeper into the technical side and into building my own tools. What draws you down the AI rabbit hole? Finding out what I can actually build with it. There’s usually another idea I want to try. Why open source? If a tool saves me time, perhaps it can save someone else an afternoon. Sharing the code also makes it easier to get useful feedback. What do you do away from the keyboard? I sprint 100 m and 200 m. My open-source projects are less good at knowing where to stop. Any non-technical dependencies? Cake. It is an excellent reason to pause a side project. Even one that was “nearly finished”. What would your ideal AI future look like? One that produces great Chuck Norris jokes.

section.p: I turn small annoyances into software projects. My idea backlog is growing faster than my repository list.

div.div: I work in communication in an IT environment and have experience in frontend work. Exploring AI led me deeper into the technical side and into building my own tools.
What draws you down the AI rabbit hole?
Finding out what I can actually build with it. There’s usually another idea I want to try.
If a tool saves me time, perhaps it can save someone else an afternoon. Sharing the code also makes it easier to get useful feedback.
What do you do away from the keyboard?
I sprint 100 m and 200 m. My open-source projects are less good at knowing where to stop.
Cake. It is an excellent reason to pause a side project. Even one that was “nearly finished”.
What would your ideal AI future look like?
One that produces great Chuck Norris jokes.
